opportunities.title: Regular Grant (under £100,000)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, Charitable Incorporated Organisations (CIOs), and exempt/excepted organisations under Charity Commission guidance. Must have at least one year's worth of annual accounts. Cannot fund individuals, CICs, community benefit societies, social enterprises, local authorities. One application at a time per organisation.
opportunities.summary: Grants under £100,000 for operating/core costs, capital projects, or projects/specific activities. Open to applications all year round with no deadlines. Operating/core cost grants typically 10-20% of an organisation's total annual budget; capital and project grants typically 10-20% of costs (local community capital projects capped at £30,000).

opportunities.title: Major Grant (£100,000 and over)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: For core costs, organisation's annual income must be £1 million or over. For capital or project costs, the total cost of the project must be at least £1 million (organisation income need not exceed £1m). Must be a UK registered charity, CIO, or exempt/excepted organisation. Local community capital projects (e.g. church or village hall) should apply for a regular grant instead.
opportunities.summary: Grants of £100,000 and over considered by Trustees at one of eight Board meetings per year. Applicants submit an Expression of Interest all year round (no deadlines), reviewed on a rolling basis. If taken forward, invited to submit a full proposal for consideration at a board meeting.
